correctness.rationale: The algebra basis 1, degree-one vertices and degree-two edges is direct. Unit multiplication is invertible and pure-degree-two nonzero multiplication has rank 1. For support S of a nonzero degree-one part, edge coefficient equations show the kernel consists exactly of untouched exterior vertices and one free alternating value per bipartite induced component (all components in characteristic two). Its dimension is z_G(S)+c_p(S), and the product with 1 contributes one new image dimension; every enumerator term and its multiplicity follows. Full support proves the sharp maximum; the cycle transfer follows from 01 transitions and 000 triples with a single full-one correction. The standalone checker constructs full multiplication matrices from the multiplication law over F_2,F_3,F_4 and independently checks exact frequencies and transfer traces. Finite checks do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: Every annihilator-size frequency of a standard finite Artinian graph face algebra is a natural invariant of multiplication, not an arbitrary numerical slice. The formula sharpens generic Lefschetz existence to an exact finite-field probability distribution, detects bipartite component counts at the extremal rank and gives a uniform four-state transfer law for all cycle lengths and every characteristic. It is meaningful independently of downstream conjectures or finite spot checks.
